n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))

def merge(arr, left, mid, right):
    n1 = mid - left + 1
    n2 = right - mid
    L = arr[left:mid+1]
    R = arr[mid+1:right+1]
    i = 0
    j = 0
    k = left
    while i < n1 and j < n2:
        if L[i] <= R[j]:
            arr[k] = L[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            arr[k] = R[j]
            j += 1
        k += 1
    while i < n1:
        arr[k] = L[i]
        i += 1
        k += 1
    while j < n2:
        arr[k] = R[j]
        j += 1
        k += 1

def mergeSort(arr, l, r):
    if l < r:
        m = l + (r - l) // 2
        mergeSort(arr, l, m)
        mergeSort(arr, m + 1, r)
        merge(arr, l, m, r)

mergeSort(a, 0, n - 1)

if n == 1:
    print(a[0])
else:
    mid = n // 2
    print(a[mid])
